s3-suspect.desc: a young man in a red cap

s3-rival-vendor.desc: a vendor from the next aisle

go-between-courier.desc: a courier in a gray jacket

stall-burns.1.1.line: {burnout-officer} walks the market plaza slowly, hands in pockets, past corners without scanning them.

stall-burns.1.2.line: Shoppers scatter from the lantern stall as flames run up the awning, and {s3-stall-owner} stays put.

stall-burns.1.3.line: {s3-stall-owner} points {burnout-officer} at the burning awning, apron balled in one fist.

stall-burns.1.4.line: {s3-stall-owner} points at a melted power strip under the counter.

stall-burns.1.5.line: {burnout-officer} stands at the scorched stall as the smoke thins out.

stall-burns.1.6.line: {burnout-officer} picks a melted gel cap off the ground and drops it in an evidence bag.

fire-log.1.1.line: {burnout-officer} sits on a plaza seat in mid-afternoon, eating noodles from a carton.

fire-log.1.2.line: {burnout-officer} reads the fire log: "Gel residue on the awning struts. Strip melted after ignition."

fire-log.1.3.line: {s3-stall-owner} tells {burnout-officer} a man came by Thursday and said "the usual."

fire-log.1.4.line: {burnout-officer} reads the same log line a third time, lips moving.

rival-words.1.1.line: {s3-rival-vendor} shouts at {s3-stall-owner} across the aisle, loud enough to turn heads.

rival-words.1.2.line: {s3-rival-vendor} jabs a finger at the scorched stall.

rival-words.1.3.line: {s3-rival-vendor} walks back to the next aisle, still muttering.

bag-at-the-counter.1.1.line: {burnout-officer} eats alone at the food counter in the middle of the afternoon.

bag-at-the-counter.1.2.line: {go-between-courier} hands {s3-suspect} a folded paper bag at the end of the counter.

bag-at-the-counter.1.3.line: {s3-suspect} walks off toward the market plaza, the bag under {s3-suspect.his} arm.

bag-at-the-counter.1.4.line: {burnout-officer} looks up from the bowl, shrugs, and goes back to eating.

ash-sift.1.1.line: {burnout-officer} crouches under the burned counter and sifts the ash with a pen.

ash-sift.1.2.line: {burnout-officer} lifts out a scorched paper corner with one printed digit still showing.

ash-sift.1.3.line: {burnout-officer} unfolds a note from under the counter: "Pay Thu, 20."

cousins.1.1.line: {s3-suspect} stands at the Neon Dome snack stand hatch, hands in {s3-suspect.his} pockets.

cousins.1.2.line: {s3-suspect} and {informant} hug across the hatch counter.

cousins.1.3.line: {informant} slides a snack token across the hatch to {s3-suspect}.

cousins.1.4.line: {s3-suspect} pockets the token and walks off into the Dome crowd.

rival-s-receipt.1.1.line: {s3-rival-vendor} digs a receipt out of a jacket pocket and hands it to {burnout-officer}.

rival-s-receipt.1.2.line: {burnout-officer} reads the receipt, stamped "22:15" at the food counter on the night of the fire.

rival-s-receipt.1.3.line: {burnout-officer} sits down on a counter stool with the receipt in hand.

rival-s-receipt.1.4.line: {burnout-officer} shrugs at {s3-rival-vendor} and slides the receipt back along the counter.

arrest-at-the-plaza.1.1.line: {burnout-officer} sits on a plaza seat facing the burnt stall, not eating, not moving.

arrest-at-the-plaza.1.2.line: {s3-suspect} stops beside the burnt stall in a red cap, hands in {s3-suspect.his} pockets.

arrest-at-the-plaza.1.3.line: {burnout-officer} stands up, and {s3-suspect} breaks into a run across the plaza.

arrest-at-the-plaza.1.4.line: {burnout-officer} catches {s3-suspect} by the collar at the edge of the plaza.

arrest-at-the-plaza.1.5.line: {burnout-officer} pulls a gel vial and half of a scorched paper stub from {s3-suspect}'s pocket.

arrest-at-the-plaza.1.6.line: {burnout-officer} walks {s3-suspect} out of the plaza toward the station.

statement.1.1.line: {s3-suspect} sits at the interview table, the red cap turning in {s3-suspect.his} hands.

statement.1.2.line: {s3-suspect} tells {burnout-officer} a courier paid {s3-suspect.him} twenty credits and a cousin said the stall had refused.

statement.1.3.line: {burnout-officer} hands the gel vial in its evidence bag to {desk-sergeant}.

leave-request.1.1.line: {burnout-officer} argues with {desk-sergeant} over a shift swap, voice low and flat.

leave-request.1.2.line: {burnout-officer} shrugs and turns away from {desk-sergeant}'s desk.

leave-request.1.3.line: {burnout-officer} reads the leave sheet on the wall three times without signing it.

leave-request.1.4.line: {burnout-officer} sits on the lobby bench, hands hanging between {burnout-officer.his} knees.

plaza-scan.1.1.line: {burnout-officer} scans each plaza corner with the handheld, one after another.

plaza-scan.1.2.line: {s3-stall-owner} steps under a new awning at the rebuilt lantern stall.

plaza-scan.1.3.line: {s3-stall-owner} hands {burnout-officer} a lidded bowl over the counter.

plaza-scan.1.4.line: {burnout-officer} eats from the bowl standing at the stall counter.
